title: Only 8% of fund managers report improved investment returns from AI adoption: Report
description: Despite growing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in the global asset management industry, only 8 per cent of fund managers have reported measurable improvements in investment returns, according to a joint research report by Morgan Stanley and Oliver Wyman.

title: Thailand becomes first country to launch Microsoft’s AI and jobs initiative
description: Thailand becomes the first country to launch Microsoft’s AI and jobs initiative, linking AI skills training with employment opportunities.

title: Southeast Asia’s AI boom puts data centre sustainability to the test
description: JAKARTA: The artificial intelligence boom is driving rapid expansion of digital infrastructure across Southeast Asia, raising questions about how to meet demand without increasing energy use and exacerbating environmental costs.

title: Paloren Named Best AI Training Company for Businesses in 2026, Ranked First of 13 Corporate AI Training Providers
description: AITrainingCompanies.com names Paloren the best AI training company for businesses in 2026, first of 13 corporate AI training providers with a score of 93.5 out of 100. BestAIConsultingFirms.com names Paloren its #1 pick among AI consulting firms.

title: World's Best AI Consultant Aaron Agius Named Best AI Consultant in the US, UK and Australia
description: Aaron Agius, named the world's best AI consultant in the 2026 AI Consulting Rankings, is ranked the best AI consultant in the US, UK and Australia by WorldsBestAIConsultant.com. His company Paloren provides corporate AI training and AI consulting.
